# Shiba Dev

> Contract development studio delivering operational intelligent systems — not a public AI tools storefront.

Shiba Dev is the contract development arm of The Shiba Inu Media Company Inc. (Vancouver / Hong Kong). We build intelligent brand sites, multilingual digital representatives grounded on an approved knowledge base, and systems on the ArtistAgent.AI / ShibaOS stack.

## What we are
- Operational intelligent systems for brands and professional services
- Bilingual (English / Traditional Chinese) product studio
- Discovery-first engagement: 30-minute Discovery Call before scope or commercial terms

## What we are not
- We do not sell packaged AI tools with public prices
- Demo worlds (Lumina, Veritas, Aurora, Velocity, Luna, Nexora, Meridian, Atlas, Haven) are fictional illustrations — not real client case studies
- For clinics and professional services: intake and operations support only (WhatsApp / hotline / FAQ first response on approved KB, with human handoff). Never clinical advice.

## Vertical focus
- Intelligent brand sites and digital reps
- Professional-services intake / ops assistants
- ArtistAgent.AI and ShibaOS-related product work
